lessons.title: Learning Our Performance Lines
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to learn and rehearse lines for a class performance.
success_criteria: I can say my line clearly.
I can remember when to speak.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the performance planned for this term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model rehearsing a line clearly with expression.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise their performance lines in small groups.
key_questions: Can you say your line clearly?

differentiation.support: Adult supports with prompts and repetition

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and performance confidence — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your lines with your family.

lessons.title: Performance Timings: Quarter Hours
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply quarter hour time-telling to a performance schedule.
success_criteria: I can read the schedule times.
I can say how long until the performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap quarter hour times from Week 8.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a performance schedule using quarter hour times.
lessons.independent_task: Children read and answer questions about a performance schedule.
resources_needed: Schedule worksheet with quarter hour times
key_questions: What time does the performance start?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of quarter hour time-telling to a real event — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Look at a schedule or timetable together.

lessons.title: Making Costumes/Props
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to make a simple costume piece or prop for the performance.
success_criteria: I can make a costume piece or prop.
I can use materials purposefully.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what costumes/props are needed for the performance.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model making a simple costume piece or prop using available materials.
lessons.independent_task: Children make their own costume piece or prop for the class performance.
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe purposeful material use for a performance — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Show your costume/prop to your family.

lessons.title: Performing with Expression
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform lines using appropriate expression and volume.
success_criteria: I can use an appropriate volume.
I can show expression in my voice.
lessons.starter_activity: Practise saying a line in different emotions (happy, sad, excited).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model performing with expression and appropriate volume.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise their lines with expression in pairs, giving each other feedback.
key_questions: How could you say that with more expression?
Is your volume right for the audience?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note development of performance skills — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Practise performing your line with expression at home.

lessons.title: Ticket Sales Data
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to interpret a simple table of performance ticket data.
success_criteria: I can read a table.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model interpreting a simple table showing ticket sales for different performance days.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer questions using a ticket sales table.
key_questions: Which day sold the most tickets?
How many more were sold on this day?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record data interpretation skill — evidence for MATHS.STAT.
lessons.home_link: Look at a table of data together (e.g. from a newspaper or website).

lessons.title: Making Performance Backdrops
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to contribute to a class backdrop for the performance.
success_criteria: I can add to the backdrop.
I can use colour purposefully.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what scene the backdrop should show.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model painting/creating part of a large class backdrop.
lessons.independent_task: Children contribute to painting/decorating the class performance backdrop.
key_questions: What will you add to the backdrop?

differentiation.greater_depth: Add detailed elements to the scene

lessons.assessment_notes: Note collaborative art contribution — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about the performance backdrop with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Performance Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read performance-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read performance words.
I can read a sentence about performing.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to performance-themed words (e.g. 'stage', 'sing', 'clap').
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading performance words over the week.

lessons.title: Measuring for the Performance Space
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to measure and compare lengths for a practical performance purpose.
success_criteria: I can measure a length in cm.
I can compare two lengths.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap measuring in cm from Week 12.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model measuring the performance space or props using a ruler/metre stick.
lessons.independent_task: Children measure props/costumes/space for the performance, recording measurements.

differentiation.greater_depth: Measure and compare multiple items independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note practical application of measuring skills — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.plenary: Recap measurements taken for the performance.

lessons.title: Finishing Touches: Costumes and Props
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to add finishing details to their costume/prop.
success_criteria: I can add a finishing detail.
I can make sure my costume/prop is ready.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss adding finishing touches to complete costumes/props.
lessons.independent_task: Children finish and check their costume/prop is performance-ready.
key_questions: What finishing touch will you add?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note completion and care taken with a finished piece — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Show your finished costume/prop to your family.

lessons.title: Full Dress Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their part in a full rehearsal.
success_criteria: I can perform my part.
I can support others in the performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole performance running order.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what a dress rehearsal involves and expectations for supporting classmates.
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in a full dress rehearsal of the class performance.

differentiation.support: Adult supports with prompts during rehearsal
differentiation.greater_depth: Take on additional responsibility (helping cues, leading a section)

lessons.assessment_notes: Note performance confidence and teamwork ahead of the final show — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Recap what went well and what to improve.
lessons.home_link: Practise your part one more time at home.

lessons.title: Performance Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve addition/subtraction word problems using a performance context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies to 100.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a performance context (e.g. audience seats filled).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve performance-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a performance-themed word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Reflecting on Our Performance Art
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on the art created for the performance.
success_criteria: I can say what I made for the performance.
I can say what I'm proud of.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created for the performance.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on a completed piece of collaborative art.
lessons.independent_task: Children reflect on and record what they contributed to the performance's art.
key_questions: What are you most proud of?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on the creative process

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language about a collaborative creative project — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the art created for the performance.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family what you made for the performance.

lessons.title: Performance Day!
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform confidently for an audience.
success_criteria: I can perform my part.
I can stay in role/on task throughout.
lessons.starter_activity: Final warm-up and recap of the running order.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Brief final tips for confident performing.
lessons.independent_task: Children perform the class Christmas performance for an audience (parents/other classes).
resources_needed: All performance materials — costumes, props, backdrop
key_questions: How did it feel to perform?

differentiation.support: Adapted role/support as needed on the day
differentiation.greater_depth: Take a lead role or extra responsibility

lessons.assessment_notes: Celebratory final assessment of spoken language, confidence and teamwork across the whole unit — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration and applause after the performance.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family how the performance went and what you enjoyed.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Autumn Term Number and Measurement Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply number and measurement skills learned across the Autumn term.
success_criteria: I can add, subtract, measure and use money confidently.
I can explain my strategies.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key vocabulary from the Autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the term's core maths content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comprehensive mixed review covering the Autumn term's key maths skills.
key_questions: Can you explain how you solved this?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Autumn term maths consolidation summary for each child.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate a great Autumn term of maths learning.
lessons.home_link: Review the Autumn term's maths learning together over the break.

lessons.title: Autumn Term Art Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their art progress across the Autumn term.
success_criteria: I can name a piece of art I'm proud of from this term.
I can say what technique I used.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created this term (self-portraits, minibeasts, firework art, poppies, decorations, performance props).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on progress made in art skills across the Autumn term.
lessons.independent_task: Children choose a favourite piece from the term and reflect on their progress.
resources_needed: Art from across the Autumn term
key_questions: What is your favourite piece from this term?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on progress and technique

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and progress recognition across the Autumn term's art learning — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of a wonderful Autumn term.
lessons.home_link: Show your family your favourite piece of art from this term.
